title: CoDaWork 2026 22-slide to 12-slide compression plan
prepared_from: ChatGPT adviser review of CODA-Association/CODAwork2026 current conference folder

current_known_package.projector: offline HTML projector with RADAR / BARY / ALIGN / SHOCK modes

user_goal.plain_language: Peter wants to cut the 22-slide talk approximately in half, down to 12 slides, because 22 slides plus data flip-through will likely exceed the time limit.
user_goal.target: 12 slides maximum for the main talk, preserving only the absolute necessary argument and leaving detailed output exploration to the cinema scroll and projector.
user_goal.constraint: Do not make 12 crowded slides. Merge concepts into stronger narrative slides and move detail into verbal notes, handout, attendee page, cinema scroll, projector, and manuscript.
user_goal.preferred_result: A 12-slide alternative deck plan Claude can use to rebuild or draft a compressed version.

core_strategy.principle: The compressed talk should be a 12-slide argument, not a 12-slide catalog.
spine: The size view hides structural work.
The five-viewpoint protocol measures structural work.
Activation Coefficient makes the hidden driver visible.
Three country archetypes show the method works in different transition regimes.
The 5-of-9 cross-country signature shows the pattern is not anecdotal.
The cinema scroll and projector carry the proof reserve.
core_strategy.hard_rule: Anything not required to make the audience understand and test the central claim moves out of the main deck.

recommended_timing.timing_note: This keeps time for the data flip-through. If the chair is strict, skip slide 12 verbally and let it be a closing/contact slide shown during questions.

new_12_slide_deck.title: Compositional monitoring of energy-mix drift on the simplex
new_12_slide_deck.role: Open the talk; state the one-sentence problem.
keep_from_old: Question: what carriers really drove each country's energy transition and which did structural work?
new_12_slide_deck.visual: Title + one-line research question + small repo/CoDaWork footer.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Frame this as a monitoring application of CoDa geometry, not as a claim to replace CoDa mathematics.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: The question is not only what got bigger; it is which carrier did the structural work.

new_12_slide_deck.title: The size view hides work
new_12_slide_deck.role: Create the need for the method.
keep_from_old: USA Solar 2012→2013: 0.107% share but 81.7% structural Power Share; Activation Coefficient ≈760×
new_12_slide_deck.visual: World or USA stacked-area view with callout: small share ≠ small work.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Use the USA Solar number as the hook early, not later.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: This number is the reason for the talk: the size view made the driver nearly invisible.

new_12_slide_deck.title: Five viewpoints, one observable stack
new_12_slide_deck.role: Introduce the method in one slide.
new_12_slide_deck.merge_instruction: Collapse old slides 4–7 into one schematic. Do not separately teach helmsman and Power Share unless asked.
new_12_slide_deck.visual: Five-viewpoint diagram with one line under each viewpoint: size / who steers / when steering changes / how much work / why small mattered.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Give the audience enough vocabulary to follow the results.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: Each view answers one question. Together they turn a compositional transition into an auditable event.

new_12_slide_deck.title: Activation Coefficient: the yeast factor
keep_from_old: α=1 expected work, α≫1 hidden driver
Solar 2010–2015 appears repeatedly as small share / large structural work
new_12_slide_deck.visual: Formula + USA Solar worked example + top yeast moment strip.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: This is the memorable diagnostic. Give it room.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: A small carrier can act like yeast: tiny in mass, large in structural effect.

new_12_slide_deck.title: Three archetypes: continuous arc, shock, regime change
new_12_slide_deck.role: Preview Germany/Japan/UK as one comparative concept.
keep_from_old: Germany = continuous arc to renewable vertex
Japan = Fukushima shock and multi-year reorganisation
UK = coal exit as regime change
Navigation chart archetypes: continuous arc / looping / jump-and-return
new_12_slide_deck.merge_instruction: Replace six old case/navigation slides with one archetype overview plus three following focused slides.
new_12_slide_deck.visual: Three-column overview: DEU, JPN, GBR with one mini-plate/icon each.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Tell audience why these three countries were selected.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: These are not three examples of the same behavior; they are three different transition regimes read by the same instrument.

new_12_slide_deck.title: Germany: deliberate transition as continuous course
keep_from_old: Solar 2005–2006 at 0.21% share doing 71.1% of work, AC≈333×
new_12_slide_deck.visual: Germany four-panel or single strongest Germany plate plus one navigation inset.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Show that the method names the beginning of structural change before size dominates.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: The structural start appears before the size view makes it obvious.

new_12_slide_deck.title: Japan: Fukushima shock and reorganisation
new_12_slide_deck.visual: Japan four-panel with gold-shaded 2011–2013 window + navigation inset.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Show the instrument detects both the shock and the multi-year reorganization.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: The shock is not one point; the composition reorganizes over several years.

new_12_slide_deck.title: United Kingdom: coal exit as regime change
keep_from_old: Wind, solar, and other renewables absorb displaced structural work
new_12_slide_deck.visual: UK four-panel or coal-exit plate with navigation inset.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Show policy-driven transition as a different archetype.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: The method separates size decline from who absorbed the structural work.

new_12_slide_deck.title: Cross-country signature: 5 of 9 reproduce the pattern
new_12_slide_deck.role: Move from anecdotes to corpus-level result.
keep_from_old: AUS, CHN, GBR, IND, JPN fire
DEU, FRA, USA, WLD do not
Protocol discriminates; it does not over-fire
new_12_slide_deck.visual: Nine-country grid or Fig. 5 cross-country signature plate.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Make it clear that non-firing countries are evidence of discrimination, not failure.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: A useful detector should not fire everywhere. Here it fires in five countries and stays quiet in four.

new_12_slide_deck.title: What the stack answers
keep_from_old: HOW MUCH work each carrier did
new_12_slide_deck.visual: Five-question synthesis table, possibly using icons from slide 3.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Rebuild the method/result into one memorable object before the falsifiability slide.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: The stack does not replace interpretation; it gives interpretation a reproducible object.

new_12_slide_deck.title: The falsifiable claim: MC-4
keep_from_old: Aitchison-native + formal change detection + carrier-level attribution
four defeat paths: prior-art, metric, case, category
new_12_slide_deck.visual: Three-conjunct claim on left, four defeat paths on right.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Show humility and invite expert challenge.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: This is the claim I want the CoDa community to test. If one of these four defeat paths succeeds, the claim narrows or fails.

new_12_slide_deck.title: Now inspect the instrument
new_12_slide_deck.role: Bridge to data scroll, projector, repo, AI declaration/contact.
keep_from_old: Cinema scroll: every plate the engine produced
AI use declaration / standard stamp compressed into footer or single small block
new_12_slide_deck.merge_instruction: Collapse old slides 18–22 into one end slide. Do not spend time on AI declaration unless required; put it as visible conformance footer.
new_12_slide_deck.visual: Three boxes: Manuscript, Cinema Scroll, Projector + QR/repo/contact footer.
new_12_slide_deck.speaker_goal: Hand the audience from talk to evidence. Then flip the data scroll.
new_12_slide_deck.must_say: I will not ask you to trust the speaker; the outputs, hashes, manuscript, and projector are open for inspection.

cinema_scroll_guidance.when_to_run: After slide 12 or immediately as slide 12 is displayed.
cinema_scroll_guidance.duration: 60–90 seconds unless the chair gives more time.
cinema_scroll_guidance.instruction: Auto-advance quickly; do not narrate every country. Say: 'This is the output field. Pause me anywhere.'
cinema_scroll_guidance.speaker_line: What follows is not more claims; it is the engine output reserve.

projector_guidance.when_to_open: During Q&A, not during the 10.5-minute compressed talk unless time remains.
projector_guidance.speaker_line: BARY shows the course; ALIGN removes the course and leaves shape variation around each year's own center.
